attributes.title: Level 1

subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓ Did you change the number of lives the hero sprite starts with in the [set life to] block?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Why do you think the game ends immediately, once the directions are read?

❓What do you think is an appropriate amount of lives for the hero sprite to begin the game with? Why?


Solution: 

The number in the white bubble of the [set life to] block should be changed from zero to a reasonably sized number greater than zero (e.g. likely between 2-5).
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, the game immediately ends once you read through the directions! 


Fix the bugs in the code so that the Player starts with at least 1 life!

subgroups.title: Debugging Life and Score Variables
subgroups.introduction:
Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


In this game, help the Player collect all of the stars and get to the chest, before the timer runs out. Don’t forget to avoid the logs along the way!

validationItems.failureText: Check that the number in the [set life to] block is larger than zero.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓ Did you switch the sprite kinds in the  [on sprite overlaps sprite] container block?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓When should the hero sprite’s points increase?

❓Where else in the game might the hero’s points increase?


Solution: 

In the [on sprite overlaps sprite] container block where the Player overlaps with the Enemy sprite, the sprite kind needs to be switched from Enemy to Food.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, there’s a bug in the code! The score increases when the Player sprite overlaps with a log sprite, instead of a star sprite. 


Fix the bugs in the code so that the score only increases when the hero overlaps with a star.

subgroups.name: solve 3

steps.hints: ❓ Did you drag the otherSprite bubble  into the [destroy sprite] block?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Why is star2 destroyed when the hero sprite overlaps with the star1 sprite? 

❓How might you use sprite kinds to problem solve this bug? 


Solution: 

The otherSprite oval from the [on sprite overlaps sprite] container block needs to be dragged into the sprite name slot of the [destroy sprite] block. This causes any food sprite kinds to be destroyed when the hero overlaps with them, not just specific sprites.
steps.instructions:
When the hero sprite overlaps with the star1 sprite, the star2 sprite is destroyed.


Fix the bugs in the code so that both star sprites are destroyed when the Player overlaps them.

attributes.description: Welcome to Level 1 of Yellow Belt! In this level, you’ll learn about variables, which are pieces of data that can be stored, updated, and used in your programs. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 1:

badges.title: Data Entry
badges.description: Use variables to keep track of data in a project.

badges.title: YOLO
badges.description: Set and change the lives variable in a project.

badges.title: Time Flies
badges.description: Set a countdown timer in a project.

badges.title: Keeping Track
badges.description: Set and change the score variable in a project.

badges.title: -poof-
badges.description: Destroy a sprite when something happens in a project.
